Shri Santosh Kumar Meena, learned counsel for the appell
 Shri Harish Singh Rathore, learned Govt. Advocate for th
 respondent/State.
Shri Ravi Sagre, learned counsel for the complainant.

Heard on I.A. No. 13354/2025, which is repeat (second) application filed under Section 430 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of appellant - Ashok.
Earlier application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 26.06.2025.

The present appellant has been convicted for commission of offences punishable under Sections 366 & 376(D) of IPC and sentenced to undergo 20 years and 05 years with fine of Rs.3,000/- &
Rs.2,000/- respectively with default stipulations.
As per prosecution case, the allegation against the present appellant is of commission of rape upon prosecutrix.
Counsel for the appellant submits that the prosecutrix is a major woman and she has pleaded no objection.
Hence, it is prayed that the jail sentence of the present appellant be suspended.
Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer.
However, counsel for the victim has no objection.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into 2 CRA-8316-2023 consideration all the facts in entirety and fact that the prosecutrix is a major woman and she has no objection, we deem it appropriate to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the present appellant.

The execution of remaining jail sentence of appellant - Ashok shall remain suspended during the pendency of the appeal and he be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Ashok Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 25 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175336269/
